continuity: Furin’s decades of secret experiments transformed the Tsar Bomba using Magic Gems and magical engineering; he renamed the weapon Vladimir after himself.
The detonation destroys Moscow and leaves it a lifeless wasteland; Morgoth is the sole survivor shown.
Morgoth uses the released Magic Gem energy to create a Dragon Lair over Moscow’s ruins and reveals it to the world.
Furin’s final warning to Morgoth is that Jin’s return will end him; Morgoth welcomes the prospect.
plot: Vladimir Furin’s secret Magic Gem-powered weapon, renamed Vladimir, detonates and destroys Moscow; Morgoth survives, shapes the released energy, and builds a Dragon Lair over the ruins. Before the blast, Furin warns Morgoth that Jin’s return will mean his end, and Morgoth says he looks forward to it.
Morgoth reveals the new lair to the world through a drone camera, announcing the arrival of the calamity.
